title: An optimal control perspective on diffusion-based generative modeling
tldr_zh: 时间反转log密度满足HJB，ELBO=verification theorem；路径空间KL表述与从未归一化密度采样的DIS
tldr_en: Time-reversed log-density solves an HJB equation; ELBO follows from the verification theorem; path-space KL view yields the DIS sampler for unnormalized densities.
